verdicts.reason: A shrinks the whole portrait poster into a tiny box in the middle of the banner, with empty strips on both sides. The headline, schedule and CTA are all unreadable, so this is a shrink and not a resize. B fills the banner and gives the 'Book a Studio Place' CTA real presence, but it is broken in other ways. The headline 'Six weeks of open studios' is gone or illegible, and one schedule row ('02 DEC / Printmaking with Ines Varga') is blown up into a false focal point. The other rows are crammed into tiny text on the right, the footer fine print overlaps the bottom row, and the logo and photo are cropped or reduced to scraps. Both are poor, but B is less bad.
